annotations.title: Locate an extraction's values on its source pages

description: For every extracted value of an extraction job (one module, or all of them), find the exact words on the source datasheet page the extraction cites and return their box: x, y, width, height normalized 0-1 to the page (origin top-left) plus bounds_pt in PDF points. Each value gets exactly one status: located (its own words boxed, inside or beside the cited snippet), located_value_only (its words occur once on the page and are boxed, but the cited snippet is not on the page), located_snippet_only (the cited snippet boxed, value text not inside it), ambiguous (found more than once, no box guessed), not_found, no_text_layer (a scan), page_unavailable, map_unavailable / map_expired (no document map), no_evidence_page (the output gives no page) or no_value_to_find (the output states no value text and no snippet). box_scope says how tight a box is: 'value' (exactly the value's characters), 'value_estimated' (the value sits inside a longer printed label; its box is estimated from its character offsets, the whole label is in container_boxes), 'label' (could not be narrowed, e.g. vertical text: the whole label is boxed) or 'snippet' (the cited snippet, not the value). matched_text is the text inside the boxes. coverage counts the statuses for the window returned and adds up to targets_returned; page through targets_total with offset / next_offset. Modules without per-value page evidence (kicad, altium and other generated outputs) are listed as not_applicable with the reason. Deterministic: reads the stored output and document map, calls no model. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key; readable jobs are your own, your workspace's TEAM-shared jobs and PUBLIC jobs, as on the REST API.

job_id.description: An extraction job in your account (or shared with it).

limit.description: Values to locate in this answer. Default 50, at most 200.

module.description: One module id, for example 'pinout' or 'absolute_max'. Omit for every module.

offset.description: Skip this many values (from next_offset). Default 0.
